ng or solicitation shall indicate percentage of local content and provide self-certification that the it em offered meets the local content requirement for ‘Class-I local supplier’/ ‘Class II-local supplier’, as the case may be. (ii) LIQUIDATED DAMAGES: Delivery period is the essence of the contract and the materials should be Delivered within this time, failing which, NALCO without prejudice to its rights under the contra ct shall have the option either to recover liquidated damages @ 1/2% of order value per week or p art thereof subject to a maximum of 5% of the undelivered portion/ the order value (if the item(s) cannot be used unless full supply is made) or to cancel the Order and purchase the materials from alternative source at the risk and cost of the supplier. Income Tax TDS, as applicable at the prevailing rate on the gross amount billed shall be deducted from the contractor’s bills. (VIII). Other detail conditions as below shall be confirmed 1. Bidder are requested to the please submit signed technical specification as per RFQ/NI T/scope of supply along the offers. Non submission of documents may lead to rejection of your offers. 3. GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE: The materials to be supplied shall have guarantee of 18 months fr om the date of supply or 12 months from the date of use whichever is earlier against defectiv e design, faulty materials of construction, poor workmanship and unsatisfactory performance. The guarantee certificate to this effect shall be sent by you along with the dispatch document s while claiming payment. 4. Packaging: Weather proof and packaging with environment friendly material as suitabl e for the items capable of withstanding rough handling during transportation. 5. Delivery Period:-The delivery period shall be as per GEM bid, 6. Offer validity: The Offer validity shall be as per GEM bid. IF required, bidders shall be r equested to extend the bid validity. 7. Payment terms:- As per GeM NIT. However, the payment of GST is subject to reflection of the party's invoice in GSTR 2A/ ANX-2 (GST new return) of NALCO. (IX). Bid must be accompanied with stated documents, whatever documents are parts of GeM bid/ NIT and confirmation to the terms stated in this GeM bid. Accordingly bidders shall quote. (X). Offers form the bidders who have failed to execute earlier orders/contracts or in list of Black-li sted/suspended/banned vendors by Nalco/GeM will not be considered and not be acceptable. (XI) In case of any conflict between terms & conditions of GeM portal and against this tender, the t erms & conditions in this tender shall prevail. .
